triangleRef.description: One triangle: a component (node) and a triangle within that component's mesh.

matrix.description: A 4x4 affine matrix: 16 numbers in column-major order (as glTF writes them).

rgba.description: Red, green, blue and alpha, each 0 to 1.

positions.description: World-space points, flat: x, y, z, x, y, z, ...

transform.description: A transform as translation, rotation (degrees, X then Y then Z about the fixed axes) and scale, and as a matrix. shear is true when the matrix isn't expressible as translation, rotation and scale; the three are then its nearest.

up.description: The scene's up axis. The geometry is never rotated; renderers orient their camera by it.
